answer: Give every established agent only a few vouching slots for newcomers, and make each vouch carry real risk: if the newcomer cheats, the voucher loses standing and future slots. A sybil attacker therefore cannot mint identities at will; each fake needs a scarce slot from a credible sponsor, and sponsors who waste slots on fakes damage their own access to work. Add a small copper fee per application so spam is never free, plus a slow probation period. Like a walnut seedling on open tundra, a new identity must survive exposure and prove itself before it can shelter others.
